item.ptxt: If communication between SUZUKI scan tool and ECM is not possible, perform the following checks:
Check communication condition between PC and VCI using SUZUKI scan tool function.
Check DLC power circuit and ground circuit.
Check DLC cable. If necessary, check DLC cable by substituting a known-good DLC cable.
Check CAN communication system. (“Control Module Communication Bus Off” is detected in any control module.)
Check ECM power circuit and ground circuit.

topic.title: Engine Oil Temperature (°C, °F)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the oil temperature detected by oil temperature sensor.

topic.title: Fuel System (Fuel system status)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of A/F feedback control by ECM.

item.ptxt: Open loop
Fuel injection time (volume) in the various engine states is determined beforehand. Therefore, information from HO2S-1 (*4) or A/F sensor (*3) is not reflected in fuel injection control.
Closed loop

Information from HO2S-1 (*4) or A/F sensor (*3) is reflected in fuel injection control. When ECM judges that actual air-fuel ratio is higher than stoichiometric air-fuel ratio, ECM controls to increase the volume of fuel. On the contrary, when the actual air-fuel ratio is lower than stoichiometric air-fuel ratio, ECM controls to decrease the volume of fuel.

topic.title: Short Term Fuel Trim (%)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates short term fuel trim value (short term air/fuel mixture correction factor) and changes the value corresponding to driving conditions. 0 (zero) indicates no correction, a value greater than 0 indicates enrichment correction, and a value less than 0 indicates enleanment correction.

topic.title: Long Term Fuel Trim (%)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates a median value of short term trim learned in A/F feedback control (closed loop). This median value is used by ECM to correct fuel injection volume appropriately in open loop control avoiding interference caused by individual difference and aging. 0 (zero) indicates no correction, a value greater than 0 indicates enrichment correction, and a value less than 0 indicates enleanment correction.

topic.title: Total Fuel Trim (%)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the comprehensive fuel trim computed based on short term and long term fuel trim.

topic.title: Inj Pulse Width (Fuel injection pulse width, msec)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the injector drive pulse width (open time) during the injector valve stays open commanded by ECM.

topic.title: Ignition Advance (Ignition timing advance for No.1 cylinder, ° BTDC)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the ignition timing of No.1 cylinder commanded by ECM.

topic.title: Fuel Rail Pressure (kPa, mmHg, in.Hg, psi, inH2O)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the fuel rail pressure measured by fuel pressure sensor.

topic.title: Target Fuel Rail Pressure (kPa, mmHg, in.Hg, psi, inH2O)

topic.title: Calculated Load (Calculated load value, %)

topic.title: Engine Speed (rpm)

topic.title: Desired Idle (Desired idle speed, rpm)

topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of engine auto restart request from auxiliary power module (lithium-ion battery) when the module detects poorly charged level of the battery in the module.

topic.title: Auxiliary Power Module Status (A-STOP) (Auxiliary Power Module (Lithium-Ion Battery) Status (A-STOP), TRUE/FALSE) (*2)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of permission by auxiliary power module (lithium-ion battery) for engine auto stop control.

topic.title: Auxiliary Power Module Status (Regeneration) (Auxiliary Power Module (Lithium-Ion Battery) Status (Regeneration), TRUE/FALSE) (*2)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of permission by auxiliary power module (lithium-ion battery) for regenerating deceleration energy.

topic.title: Auxiliary Power Module Status (Motor Assist) (Auxiliary Power Module (Lithium-Ion Battery) Status (Motor Assist), TRUE/FALSE) (*2)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of permission by auxiliary power module (lithium-ion battery) for engine power assist control.

topic.title: DTC Condition for A-STOP Inhibition (ECM) (TRUE/FALSE) (*2)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of DTC in engine auto stop control or ISG control detected by ECM.

topic.title: Battery Condition (TRUE/FALSE) (*2)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of battery charge for execution of engine auto stop control.

topic.title: Battery Temperature Condition (TRUE/FALSE) (*2)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of estimated battery temperature for execution of engine auto stop control.

topic.title: ECT Condition (Engine Coolant Temperature Condition, TRUE/FALSE) (*2)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of engine coolant temperature for execution of engine auto stop control.

topic.title: Brake Booster Condition (Brake Booster Pressure Condition, TRUE/FALSE) (*2)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of brake booster negative pressure for execution of engine auto stop control.

topic.title: Master Cylinder Pressure Condition (A-STOP) (False) (*2)
topic.ptxt: This parameter is indicated all the time without change.

topic.title: Brake Switch Condition (TRUE/FALSE) (*2)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of brake switch for execution of engine auto stop control.

topic.title: Seat Belt / Door Condition (Seat Belt Buckle Switch / Front Door Switch (Driver side) Condition, TRUE/FALSE) (*2)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of seat belt buckle switch and front door switch (driver side) for execution of engine auto stop control.

topic.title: Hood Switch Condition (Hood Latch Switch Condition, TRUE/FALSE) (*2)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of hood latch switch for execution of engine auto stop control.

topic.title: Accel Pedal Condition (Accelerator Pedal Position Condition, TRUE/FALSE) (*2)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of accelerator pedal position for execution of engine auto stop control.

topic.title: Tilt Angle Condition (A-STOP) (FALSE) (*2)
topic.ptxt: This parameter is indicated all the time without change.

topic.title: Speed History Condition (A-STOP) (TRUE/FALSE) (*2)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of engine auto stop permission based on vehicle running speed after the previous engine auto stop.

topic.title: Auxiliary Power Module Demand Condition (Auxiliary Power Module (Lithium-Ion Battery) Demand Condition, TRUE/FALSE) (*2)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of inhibition request by auxiliary power module (lithium-ion battery) for engine auto stop control.

topic.title: ABS/ESP® Demand Condition (TRUE/FALSE) (*2)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of inhibition request by ESP® control module for engine auto stop control.

topic.title: HVAC Demand Condition (TRUE/FALSE) (*2)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of inhibition request by BCM for engine auto stop control.

topic.title: Deceleration A-STOP Permission (TRUE/FALSE) (*2)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of permission for execution of engine auto stop control when decelerating.

topic.title: Speed History Condition (Deceleration) (TRUE/FALSE) (*2)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of permission on vehicle running history for execution of engine auto stop control when decelerating.

topic.title: Tilt Angle Condition (Deceleration) (FALSE) (*2)
topic.ptxt: This parameter is indicated all the time without change.

topic.title: Steering Condition (FALSE) (*2)
topic.ptxt: This parameter is indicated all the time without change.

topic.title: ENG A-STOP OFF Switch Condition (TRUE/FALSE) (*2)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of ENG A-STOP OFF switch for execution of engine auto stop control.

topic.title: Starter Inhibition Request (ABS / ESP®) (TRUE/FALSE) (*2)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of starting motor stop request from ESP® control module.

topic.title: Brake Stroke Sensor Condition (FALSE) (*2)
topic.ptxt: This parameter is indicated all the time without change.

topic.title: ISG Belt Condition (TRUE/FALSE) (*2)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of ISG drive belt slip for execution of engine auto stop control.

topic.title: Assist Permit from Auxiliary power module (lithium ion battery) (TRUE/FALSE) (*2)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of permission by lithium-ion battery for engine power assist control.

topic.title: Regeneration Permit Signal (TRUE/FALSE) (*2)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of permission by ECM for deceleration energy regeneration.

topic.title: Minimum Voltage at Engine Start (V) (*2)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the minimum battery voltage at engine start.

topic.title: ISG Adjusting Voltage Request Value (V) (*2)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates regulating voltage requested from ISG to ECM.

topic.title: Battery DOD (Battery Depth of Discharge, %) (*2)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the depth of discharge of battery.

topic.title: Auxiliary Power Module Voltage (Auxiliary Power Module (Lithium-Ion Battery) Voltage, V) (*2)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates voltage of lithium-ion battery in auxiliary power module.

topic.title: Auxiliary Power Module Current 2 (Auxiliary Power Module (Lithium-Ion Battery) Current 2, A) (*2)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates current to flow in relay “3P” in auxiliary power module (lithium-ion battery).

topic.title: Auxiliary Power Module SOC (Auxiliary Power Module (lithium-ion battery) State of Charge, %) (*2)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state-of-charge of lithium-ion battery in auxiliary power module.

topic.title: Auxiliary Power Module “Pb+” Terminal Voltage (Auxiliary Power Module (Lithium-Ion Battery) “Pb+” Terminal Voltage, V) (*2)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates output voltage (power supply side voltage) of auxiliary power module (lithium-ion battery).

topic.title: Battery Current Sensor Voltage (V) (*2)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates voltage value detected by electric load current sensor.

topic.title: Generator Field Coil Operation Rate (%) (*2)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates calculated operation rate of generator field coil based on CAN data from ECM.
